name: Exact Online
description: Exact Online — the Dutch accounting and ERP standard: accounts, sales and purchase invoices, items, stock, GL accounts and outstanding receivables. OData REST API, OAuth 2.0, scoped to one administration.
instructions:
**Getting a token**
1. Register an app in the **Exact Online App Centre** for your country (`apps.exactonline.com`). You receive a client id and client secret.
2. Run the authorization-code flow once against your country's host. Keep the **refresh token** — Exact's access tokens last ten minutes, so the refresh token is the only value worth storing.
3. Set `EXACT_CLIENT_ID`, `EXACT_CLIENT_SECRET`, `EXACT_REFRESH_TOKEN`, `EXACT_BASE_HOST` and `EXACT_DIVISION`.

**The host is country-specific.** `start.exactonline.nl` for the Netherlands, `.be` for Belgium, `.de` for Germany, `.co.uk`, `.fr`, `.es`, `.com` for the US. A token issued on one host does not work on another, and this is the most common cause of a 401 that looks like a bad secret. Set `EXACT_BASE_HOST` to the one your customer is on, hostname only.

**Division is the administration id**, a number. One Exact account can hold dozens of administrations and every data path carries one. `exact_online_get_me` returns `CurrentDivision` — use it to find the right value for `EXACT_DIVISION`.

**Rate limits are strict and enforced per app.** Exact allows on the order of 60 calls a minute and a few thousand a day. The response headers carry the remaining budget. Bulk work needs pacing, not retrying.

**OData v3-flavoured.** `$select`, `$filter`, `$top`, `$orderby`, `$expand` all work. `$filter` uses single quotes for strings and `datetime'2026-01-01'` for dates. Always `$select` — Exact entities have very many columns.

**Cloud reachability**: the Exact hosts are public with valid certificates.

tools.name: exact_online_get_me
tools.description: Read the authenticated user and, importantly, their CurrentDivision — the administration id every other path needs. Start here to find the right EXACT_DIVISION.

tools.name: exact_online_list_divisions
tools.description: List the administrations (divisions) this account can reach, with their code, description and currency. A customer with several companies has several divisions.

tools.name: exact_online_list_accounts
tools.description: List accounts — Exact's customers, suppliers and prospects — with their code, name, VAT number and status. Always $select; accounts have well over a hundred columns.

filter.description: OData $filter expression, e.g. IsSales eq true.

top.description: Maximum rows to return (Exact pages at 60).

tools.name: exact_online_list_sales_invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices with their number, date, account, amounts and status. Filter by InvoiceDate for a period, or by Status for what is still open.

tools.name: exact_online_list_receivables
tools.description: List outstanding receivables with their invoice number, account, due date and amount still open — the direct answer to 'who owes us money'.

filter.description: OData $filter, e.g. DueDate lt datetime'2026-09-01' for overdue only.

tools.name: exact_online_list_purchase_invoices
tools.description: List purchase invoices with their supplier, date, due date and amount — the payables side of the ledger.

tools.name: exact_online_list_items
tools.description: List items from the product catalogue with their code, description, sales price, cost price and unit.

filter.description: OData $filter expression, e.g. IsSalesItem eq true.

tools.name: exact_online_list_stock_positions
tools.description: Read current stock positions per item and warehouse — the availability answer, separate from the item master.

tools.name: exact_online_list_gl_accounts
tools.description: List general ledger accounts with their code, description, type and balance side, for questions that need the chart of accounts.
